claim: M702 apparent short-horizon step resistance R_sh: events, per-drive medians, T-lin trend per stratum, vreg comparison, simulation gate

abs_diff.note: CIs overlap; both include zero; differences from a 5-event set difference (own extractor from spec text)

simulation.author_like_generator_reproduced: multiplicative scale, gap-dependent truth R(g): fast t 0.124-0.132, slow 0.108-0.12 (author 0.12/0.124)
simulation.cause: mainly the generator: the 'null' truth R(g)=60+80(1-exp(-g/5)) is gap-dependent and the real gap trends with date (corr gap-months 0.47 fast, 0.21 slow), so the null planted an implied drift of ~0.70 (fast) / 0.31 (slow) mOhm/month (~1 / 0.4 %/month), not a zero drift; removing gap dependence gives fast 0.044-0.052. Residual genuine part: CR1 mildly liberal at G=40/56 (slow stays ~0.09-0.10 under the author's multiplicative noise; CR2 0.076)
simulation.diagnostic_only: t(G-1) CR1 ~ marginal; CR2 and day-bootstrap hold size in own generator; no gate changed

method_concerns: Sim ICC code sqrt(ICC/(1-ICC))*0.08 assumes drive residual 0.08 but uses 0.05, so realised ICC ~0.5 not 0.3
MDE base hard-coded 130 mOhm vs observed median ~104-111; planted truth ignores gap-induced drift, probably explains slow coverage 0.898
SoC/bias-by-SoC not testable (stated); T planted multiplicative vs additive linear control
No look-ahead, no CV, no row-level resampling: M634 analyse_metric clusters by calendar day; no multiplicity beyond pre-registered specs
Spec ambiguities: pre-step 'within 1 s' vs 2 samples at slow cadence; order of exclusion reasons; plausible range (0,0.5) strict
language_concerns: Gate failure must stay 'trend not established / simulation gate failed', not 'no drift'
R_sh is gap-dependent, never pooled across strata; vreg difference -21..-30 mOhm is method disagreement, not a bias claim
verdict: accept for reproduction; sim over-rejection is largely an artefact of the gap-dependent null, so report the gate failure as 'generator null not drift-free', not as proof CR1 is invalid
